brief: An open-source desktop screenshot tool for Windows, Linux and macOS. Its one unusual trick: select a region once, press a key for every capture, and the shots are appended into a single tall image. Used by developers, QA and documentation people; the GitHub README and the system tray are its main stages.
criteria: Reads at 16 px in a monochrome tray, works in one colour, says 'capture + join' without a camera, scissors or lens.

concepts.name: Seam
concepts.idea: One tall frame whose middle bar is a running stitch: two shots joined by the selection marquee itself.
rationale: The dashed line is both the selection marquee and the stitch, so the mark says capture and join in one shape
A tall frame hints at the tall image the tool produces
Built on an 8-unit grid with one outer radius; a 3-stitch cut keeps it crisp at 16 px
Seam Blue with Thread Yellow stitches is ownable next to ShareX's flat blue, Snagit's red and Greenshot's green

recommendation: Seam, in Seam Blue (#2457C5) with Thread Yellow (#FFC43D) stitches on tiles and dark grounds; one-colour blue or black elsewhere.
